cards.name: Armor of Thorns
cards.note: Enchant nonblack creature and +2/+2 work; casting it as though it had flash, with the sacrifice at the next cleanup step when cast at a time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, is not played, so the Aura can only be cast at sorcery speed.

cards.name: Asmira, Holy Avenger
cards.note: Flying works; the end-step +1/+1 counters are not played, because the only count of creatures that died this turn takes every player's creatures, not only those put into your graveyard, and would grow Asmira on the opponent's deaths.

cards.name: Binding Agony
cards.note: enchants target creature and triggers when enchanted creature is dealt damage to deal 1 damage to its controller; dealing damage equal to the exact amount of damage dealt to the enchanted creature is not supported

cards.name: Bone Harvest
cards.note: puts target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library and draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep; targeting any number of creature cards (including zero) rather than a single target creature card is not supported

cards.name: Circle of Despair
cards.note: Target yourself to prevent the next damage a chosen source would deal to you this turn; chosen-source prevention for other players and creatures is unsupported.

cards.name: Civic Guildmage
cards.note: gives target creature +0/+1 until end of turn for {G}, {T}; the {U}, {T} ability that puts a creature you control on top of its owner's library is left off because OwnerPutsOnTopOrBottom lets the owner choose top or bottom, which is not printed

cards.name: Coral Fighters
cards.note: Optionally putting the top card of defending player's library on the bottom of their library after looking at it is not yet supported (`LookAtTopOf` does not offer a top-or-bottom fateseal choice on another player's library); in play, when Coral Fighters attacks and isn't blocked, you look at the top card of defending player's library.

cards.name: Crimson Hellkite
cards.note: has flying; the {X}, {T} damage ability is left off because "spend only red mana on X" cannot be said for an activated ability, and with any colour paying X it would be stronger than printed

cards.name: Dream Cache
cards.note: draws three cards and puts two cards from your hand on top of your library; the option to put both cards on the bottom of your library instead is not in Effect

cards.name: Early Harvest
cards.note: Target yourself to untap all basic lands you control; filtering basic lands controlled by another targeted player is unsupported.

cards.name: Ebony Charm
cards.note: the exile mode takes at most one target card instead of up to three: 'from a single graveyard' is narrowed for an activated ability only, never for a spell, so up to three targets could come from two graveyards; the drain and fear modes are as printed

cards.name: Favorable Destiny
cards.note: gives the enchanted white creature +1/+2, and gives shroud to the enchanted creature while you control it and another creature; when the Aura is on a creature another player controls, the shroud (which depends on that player controlling another creature) is not given, which is weaker than printed

cards.name: Grave Servitude
cards.note: enchants target creature, giving it +3/-1 and making it black, but only at sorcery speed: flash is left off because its drawback (the Aura is sacrificed at the beginning of the next cleanup step if cast when a sorcery couldn't have been cast) cannot be said, and flash without it would be stronger than printed

cards.name: Hakim, Loreweaver
cards.note: has flying and destroys all Auras attached to Hakim for {U}{U}, {T}; returning an Aura card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim during your upkeep is left off because no effect attaches a returned card to the source (returning it to your hand is not printed)

cards.name: Haunting Apparition
cards.note: has flying, chooses an opponent as it enters, and has base power and toughness 1/2; setting its power equal to 1 plus the number of green creature cards in the chosen player's graveyard is not in PtCount

cards.name: Lightning Reflexes
cards.note: enchants target creature and gives it +1/+0 and first strike, cast at sorcery speed only; casting it as though it had flash, with the sacrifice at the next cleanup step when it is cast at a time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, is not supported (flash is left off, since without the sacrifice it would be stronger than printed)

cards.name: Mangara's Blessing
cards.note: Trigger::DiscardedThisByOpponent records the pre-move hand version without a graveyard departure successor, so the delayed end-step trigger cannot return this card from the graveyard to your hand; casting this spell gains 5 life and discarding it to an opponent's spell or ability gains 2 life

cards.name: Painful Memories
cards.note: looks at target opponent's hand; choosing a card from it and putting it on top of that player's library is not in the DSL (PutFromHandOnTop is the caster's own hand), so no card moves

cards.name: Phyrexian Dreadnought
cards.note: The engine has no multi-creature total-power sacrifice cost for "unless you sacrifice any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater"; this creature has trample and sacrifices itself when its enters-the-battlefield trigger resolves

cards.name: Phyrexian Purge
cards.note: The engine has no per-target additional life cost scaling ("costs 3 life more to cast for each target"); casting this spell pays 3 life as an additional cost and destroys one target creature

cards.name: Sabertooth Cobra
cards.note: delayed next-upkeep poison counter unless the damaged player pays {2} before that step is not in the engine; triggers when Sabertooth Cobra deals damage to a player to give that player a poison counter

cards.name: Shadow Guildmage
cards.note: the {U}, {T} ability (put target creature you control on top of its owner's library) is missing: the only effect that tucks a permanent, OwnerPutsOnTopOrBottom, lets the owner choose the bottom as well; the {R}, {T} ability deals 1 damage to any target and 1 damage to you as printed

cards.name: Shadowbane
cards.note: Effect::PreventNextFromChosenSource prevents the next damage the chosen source would deal to you rather than also protecting creatures you control, and does not check whether the source is black to grant life; prevents the next damage a chosen source would deal to you this turn

cards.name: Sirocco
cards.note: target player reveals their hand; the per-card choice to pay 4 life or discard each revealed blue instant card is not in the engine, so nothing is discarded

cards.name: Soar
cards.note: enchants a creature and gives it +0/+1 and flying, cast at sorcery speed only; casting it as though it had flash, with the sacrifice at the next cleanup step when it is cast at a time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, is not supported (flash is left off, since without the sacrifice it would be stronger than printed)

cards.name: Stalking Tiger
cards.note: 3/3 Cat without "can't be blocked by more than one creature": no blocker-count restriction on a single attacker exists yet

cards.name: Tainted Specter
cards.note: flying only: the {1}{B}{B}, {T} ability (target player discards a card unless they put a card from their hand on top of their library; if they discard, 1 damage to each creature and each player) is not played, since no effect lets that player choose and nothing checks whether they discarded

cards.name: Vigilant Martyr
cards.note: {W}{W}, {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target spell that targets an enchantment is not played: no filter says a spell that targets an enchantment

cards.name: Ward of Lights
cards.note: cast at sorcery speed only: the optional flash is not played, since nothing says that casting it any time a sorcery couldn't have been cast makes its controller sacrifice it at the beginning of the next cleanup step, and flash without that sacrifice would be stronger than printed; enchant creature, the color chosen as it enters and protection from that color (this Aura stays) are played

cards.name: Warping Wurm
cards.note: phasing and upkeep trigger phasing out unless you pay {2}{G}{U}; no phase-in trigger ('Whenever this creature phases in, put a +1/+1 counter on it') exists yet

cards.name: Zirilan of the Claw
cards.note: the 3/4 body only: the {1}{R}{R}, {T} Dragon search is not played, since no effect can name the Dragon it puts onto the battlefield for its haste until end of turn and its exile at the beginning of the next end step, and without them the Dragon would stay for good
